description: This file defines an Android Activity class 'Tooltips' which demonstrates the use of tooltips within an Android app. It sets a tooltip text for a view identified by 'tooltips_code' during activity creation.

classes.name: Tooltips
classes.description: An Android Activity that demonstrates setting a tooltip text on a view in the layout.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets a tooltip text on a specific view.
